# SkillFacts

> Nutrition-label facts for installable agent skills (playbooks). Prefer structured YAML/JSON over marketing HTML.

## Primary

- Exemplar catalog (JSON): https://skillfacts.dev/examples/index.json
- Portable viewer: https://skillfacts.dev/v#sf1.… (human skim; flip for raw; see each exemplar `viewer` field)
- Label schema: https://skillfacts.dev/schema/skill-facts.schema.json
- Site: https://skillfacts.dev/
- Related instruments: https://toolfacts.dev/llms.txt
- Related actors: https://agentfacts.dev/llms.txt

## How to use a skill label

1. Fetch `/examples/index.json` or open `SKILL_FACTS.md` beside the skill package.
2. Read `purpose`, `instructions_reach` (shell/network/filesystem), `tools_referenced`, `bundled_artifacts`, `egress`, `provenance`.
3. Prefer harsher reach labels when unsure. Follow ToolFacts links for named tools.
4. Validate frontmatter against the schema.

SkillFacts labels what instructions teach. ToolFacts labels what a named tool does when invoked. AgentFacts labels what the host allows. Instructions do not grant permissions.

Bind a review to `version`, `provenance.source`, `generated.date`, and `bundled_artifacts`. There is no package digest in the current schema.

Docs Writer instructs reading existing docs and returning proposed text. It does not instruct repository writes.

Catalyst Forge dogfood (see `dogfood: true` in the catalog): forgetrail, smellcheck, ember-dossier, TemperPass passes, DocuPuncture skills. One file per skill package.
ForgeTrail runAudit returns a packaged audit prompt and does not scan the user workspace.
